conversation.text: Just as Xueyu's gaze began to blur and her knees grew weak, a dark shadow suddenly darted out! The man-eating creature's massive maw, lined with sharp teeth, clamped down hard on Xueyu's left shoulder. With a sickening sound of tearing muscle and sinew, it violently dragged her backward. The intense pain, like an ice spike piercing her mind, instantly dispelled the cloying drowsiness and cleared her thoughts. She grunted, cold sweat beading on her forehead. Without any hesitation, she used her right hand to slash backward with the blood-stained saw cleaver—the blade scraping against bone produced a heart-stopping sound, forcibly prying the still-gnawing creature off her shoulder. The next moment, she pressed the twisted creature onto the saw cleaver. The man-eater let out a mix of painful and greedy shrieks as it fused with the weapon. The saw cleaver, now attached to a living monster, seemed to gain a life of its own. The blood on the blade boiled once more, actively meeting the falling petals. Where the blade swept, the tragically beautiful cherry blossom petals were drawn into and devoured by the ominous red light, as if bitten by an invisible mouth, dissipating into nothingness. Xueyu's left shoulder was now a mangled mess of flesh and blood, quickly soaking through her sleeve. Blood dripped from her fingertips onto the dark jade floor tiles, spreading into a small, glaring patch of red. Her face paled from blood loss, but her eyes regained their razor-sharp edge.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Man-eater... I can feel your hunger..." #Raising her left arm horizontally, she placed the saw cleaver beneath it and without hesitation sawed off the entire left arm. The man-eater then swiftly swept over, devoured the arm, and attached itself to the stump, transforming into an arm-like shape. Countless mouths repeating a "chewing" motion then split open along the arm. "Then... devour everything before us, until 'we' are no longer hungry, until 'we' are momentarily satisfied!" #Biting the saw cleaver with the mouths on the "left arm," the man-eater danced and devoured all the Spring Energy around it as if in a frenzied excitement. Xueyu then slammed the left arm into the floor. The arm composed of the man-eater devoured without restraint underground, swelling until it became massive, as large as a typical building. Then, this building-sized maw lunged forward to bite Yuyuko. And in an imperceptible corner, the girl, whose arm had somehow been restored, silently dragged the saw cleaver to Yuyuko's back. She swung the blade down at the exact same moment the giant maw was about to bite down, just like... a "mouth" and a "tongue."
